0.text: What, pray tell - do we have here? A stranger standing before ME - the great and powerful Brother Pavara!
Are you the one in charge?
….I am the shadow with a thousand swords, the blade that always cuts, lord and leader of our Brotherhood. At your service.
I have come to convince you of an alliance.
An alliance? Against whom? The Order of Ma’at? Oh dear, haven’t you heard? Us Assassins take no sides in the wars of men. Not unless a large portion of Dram is cast at our feet!

1.text: ...Still, I am no friend of the Order, and they have been an insurmountable nuisance as of late…

0.text: War bores me, taking sides bores me. But pushing a noble knight, like you $NAME - simply  to see how far you  will go to get what you desire…. Now that’s fun!
What would you ask of me?

This contract found it's way to us recently from an anonymous client. The target? Claudie da LaForge. You will get nothing more than a name and a location from us. You will have to imagine what terrible deeds she has done to deserve this fate...if any.

1.text: She’s from Narrow Orchard, but my spies tell me that she makes frequent trips to Wenderwood, perhaps you could ambush her on the open road?

2.text: Were you to take on this contract yourself, and murder dear sweet Claudie, then I’ll agree to meet with your leader to discuss this “cause” of yours.

0.text: Fantastic! Well, off you go then, my young assassin - and make sure she breathes her last.
Such a shame. Then I can’t help you. Come see me once you’re ready to swallow that pride.

Oh! Well, perhaps you’re not as perfect as you once thought! Tell me, did she cry? Wet her britches? Plead for her mother? Wait, I don’t wish to know - my imagination is far more... savory than your facts.

A deal’s a deal. I’ll meet with Markos, perhaps he’ll be more challenging to corrupt than you were… Oh, I almost forgot, your payment for completing the contract. Perhaps you could have a career in this field!

1.text: There’s always a use for someone with your talents when names float our way... speak to one of the Brothers, you’ll know them by the black cloaks they wear - if you care to make an extra Dram or two.
